rationales.authenticity: Céilí and sídhe used naturally; practical explanations (night watchmen, céilí torches) period-plausible.
rationales.character: Good skeptical voice with gentle humor; acknowledges folklore without endorsing it.
rationales.craft: Three sentences lean narrative; could be tighter for the 2-4 sentence brief.
rationales.language: Well-formed prose with natural idiom and no anachronism.
rationales.responsiveness: Offers practical explanation while acknowledging the folkloric interpretation.
